labels: add-a-beam (b): beam 1 always on, beam 2 switched; w2 1.25, eps_B 0; each state designed with its own real beta/k0 (1.33 / 1.26)
gains calibrated with the board_K2_default offsets (state 1 -1.78 dB, state 2 -2.7 dB): TO BE RE-CALIBRATED with the v2 HFSS offsets before running (see recalibration)

design.id: RO3006 r 2.30, add-a-beam (b), one group D_*

states.name: circuit ON (diodes ON): beam 1 + beam 2
states.D_sheets: one Impedance boundary, Rs = 6.1 ohm/sq (W/L = 2.5), reactance 0

probe.model: thin-pin FD, PinLength 5.0 mm, bare launch geometry (cells from 6.5 mm): R 24 ohm, X +5 ohm -> S11 -9 dB; with the launch pad (rho_in 2.6 mm, UNVALIDATED): R 43 ohm, X +9 ohm -> S11 -18 dB
probe.acceptance: S11 <= -10 dB (goal -15 dB), tuned in HFSS with PinLength 4.5-6.5 mm
probe.tuning_direction: +1 mm PinLength: R +11 ohm, X +25 ohm; pad radius / PinLength / pin diameter are the HFSS variables
probe.note: the hologram's loading of the probe is NOT modelled; the model's baseline probe gave -12.7 dB against HFSS -15 dB

sidelobe_floor: SLL_total = max(aperture SLL, 10 log(NB x 2.0) - gain): NB = (1 - launch) + launch x SW_at_edge is the state-independent diffuse power (direct probe + edge; HFSS ffd of board_K2_default: ring 60-90 + back = 71-76 % of the power, uniform in azimuth, D about 1.6 dBi). The strongest HFSS sidelobes of that board (8.3 / 8.2 dBi) are conical rings at theta 12-26 deg from the state-common static hologram, which the model underestimates by 10-17 dB: the MODEL SLL IS NOT VALIDATED
falsifiers: beam 1 more than 3 deg from (25, 0) in either state; beam-2 on/off contrast (state 2 minus state 1 level at (25, 180)) below 8 dB; beam balance in state 2 worse than 6 dB; beam 1 more than 4 dB below the prediction after re-calibration; strongest sidelobe above the gap-corrected SLL by more than 3 dB
NA: RO3006 r 2.3 cell eigenfrequencies in HFSS (the r 2.20 cell is checked)
tolerance / pointing over corners (later work, paper notes)

recalibration.rule: offset_k = HFSS gain of the v2 board in state k (design direction) minus the raw model gain of v2 in state k; add the new offset_k to the raw model gains of this board (beam1_gain_dbi_raw_model, beam2_gain_dbi_raw_model) of the same state
recalibration.example: calibrated beam 1 in state 2 = raw (17.89) + offset_2

sll_definition: highest peak outside the first null of every wanted beam (2 x HPBW if none), relative to the stronger beam; the HFSS gap seen on board_K2_default with this definition is +4.1 dB (model -4.8 / -5.3, HFSS -0.7 / -1.2)
xpd_note: XPD not computed for this variant
